mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances during monetary easing cycles despite FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.2pp increase over 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) in the prior month signal weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO > 1.0% drop over 3 months) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1.0% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized > 2.0%) signals robust economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in strong growth regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST > 2.0% drop over 3 months) signals weakening residential sector activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST declines > 2.0% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous slowdown in employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE rise > 0.1pp) in the prior month signals labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in the prior month.
